newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent unchanged after OPEC freezes ceiling.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent unchanged after OPEC freezes ceiling.

text.p: IPE Brent futures were unchanged following OPEC's announcement on Thursday it had agreed to freeze its output ceiling.
OPEC Secretary-General Rilwanu Lukman said the organisation would leave its 25.03 million barrel per day output ceiling unchanged for the first six months of next year.
"It's not a surprise," said one trader. "It's what the market was expecting and it was already factored in."
January Brent was trading 15 cents higher at $22.87 a barrel at 1154 GMT, while December gas oil was trading $2.50 higher at $218.75 a tonne.
Lukman said the 11 member oil producing group would meet again late in June 1997.
